aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We create practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping these businesses take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing without hassle and lose less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Even so, much of the software available to them was designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make life easier for people who run a food truck, with tools designed for the way these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab was born from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a guide that helps people discover the food trucks that come through their area, I spent more time understanding the challenges of food-on-wheels businesses. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always on the move, working in different places and serving customers in conditions that change all the time.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Link a pager number to the order when you hand over the device, so you know which pager belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one goes straight to the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.

featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as the automatic replies on WhatsApp, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — counter and kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your team their own logins, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online orders are paused so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own link and QR code for orders.

featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.

featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a compatible phone, without needing a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time, spreading demand across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, paid on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Manage your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answer questions on WhatsApp about your menu and your schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and the card machine you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was made for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online orders are paused automatically so customers do not place orders you will not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the artwork you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Less queueing, and the food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where will you be tonight?” “Which desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you drive to the spot or are at the griddle, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where will you be tonight?” “Which desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you drive to the spot or are at the griddle. Messenger and Instagram shortly after.
landing.final.lede: Send a photo or screenshot of your menu and we turn it all into a working ordering page, for you to test freely in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Take a look and then decide.

comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is an ordering system for a food truck?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose the dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS or a card machine takes payment at the food truck. One complements the other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe's fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract term?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no advance notice. You can cancel whenever you want; the monthly fee is charged every month, in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have already paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with spots that change?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you will be there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the pickup times your kitchen can really meet. The system uses each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a certified till?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS and has no fiscal certification. How to record online orders in your till is a question for your accountant.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab accept?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not accepted at the moment.

comparison.features.localpay.label: Local payment methods (BLIK, iDEAL, Swish, MobilePay…)

comparison.features.paypal.explain: Customers can pay with PayPal or Klarna.

comparison.features.kds.label: Kitchen screen (KDS)
comparison.features.kds.explain: Orders appear on a screen in the kitchen, in preparation order.

comparison.features.tickets.explain: Each order comes out on a ticket printer in the food truck.
comparison.features.tickets.ours: in the iPad and Android app; printer not included
comparison.features.buzzers.label: Pagers

comparison.features.offline.explain: Orders and changes made without a connection are saved and sent when the connection comes back.
comparison.features.offline.ours: in the iPad and Android app; not in the web dashboard
comparison.features.vans.label: Several food trucks or vehicles
comparison.features.vans.explain: A single account manages more than one food truck.
comparison.features.vans.ours: additional food trucks for an extra monthly fee
comparison.features.staff.label: Team logins
comparison.features.staff.explain: Each staff member signs in with their own login and role.
comparison.features.reports.label: Sales reports
comparison.features.reports.explain: Totals, best sellers and sales by event or date, with export to a spreadsheet.
comparison.features.domain.label: Own domain
comparison.features.domain.explain: The ordering page on the business's own domain.
comparison.features.whatsapp.label: Automatic replies on WhatsApp
comparison.features.whatsapp.explain: Customers' messages on WhatsApp are answered automatically.
comparison.features.social.label: Social media posts from the schedule
comparison.features.social.explain: Ready-made posts showing where the food truck will be this week.
comparison.features.igmsg.label: Replies on Instagram and Messenger
comparison.features.igmsg.explain: Instagram and Facebook Messenger messages are answered automatically.
comparison.features.discovery.label: Presence on a food-truck discovery map
comparison.features.discovery.explain: Customers find the food truck on a public map of food trucks near them.
comparison.features.loyalty.label: Loyalty programme
comparison.features.loyalty.explain: Customers earn rewards for coming back.
comparison.features.ipad.label: App for iPad
comparison.features.ipad.explain: The food truck's app for receiving and managing orders on an iPad.
comparison.features.android.label: App for Android
comparison.features.android.explain: The same app on an Android tablet or cell phone.
comparison.features.hardware.label: Equipment supplied (tablet, printer)
comparison.features.hardware.explain: The vendor delivers the tablet or the printer.
comparison.features.terminal.label: Card machine for the counter supplied
comparison.features.terminal.explain: The vendor delivers a card machine for payments at the food truck.
comparison.features.fiscal.label: Till certified under the tax rules (TSE, EET, kassaregister…)
comparison.features.fiscal.explain: A till certified under the country's rules for recording sales.
comparison.features.delivery.label: Delivery
comparison.features.delivery.explain: Orders delivered to the customer's address.
comparison.features.monthly.label: Monthly fee
comparison.features.monthly.explain: How much the business pays per month for the software.
comparison.features.perorder.label: Fee per online order
comparison.features.perorder.explain: How much the vendor charges on each online order, on top of the monthly fee.
comparison.features.cardfee.label: Card fee
comparison.features.cardfee.explain: The payment provider's fee on each card payment.
comparison.features.term.label: Minimum contract term
comparison.features.term.explain: How long the business is tied to the contract before it can cancel.
comparison.features.setup.label: Sign-up fee
comparison.features.setup.explain: A one-off amount charged at the start.
comparison.features.trial.label: Free trial
comparison.features.trial.explain: A period to use the system free before paying.

nativeShell.binary.cameraUsage: HatchGrab uses the camera so you can photograph your menu board, your dishes and other documents and upload (send) them straight to your account. The images are used only for the uploads you choose to make.
nativeShell.binary.bluetoothUsage: HatchGrab uses Bluetooth to connect to your kitchen’s thermal (receipt) printer, so that order tickets can be printed automatically. Bluetooth is not used for anything else.
nativeShell.binary.localNetworkUsage: HatchGrab connects to your kitchen’s printer on your local network so that order tickets are printed automatically. Local network access is not used for anything else.
